headlines.title: UMass Memorial Health Announces Unified Data Platform Multi-Year Initiative, Investments in AI-Powered Innovation in Partnership with Accenture and Microsoft
headlines.summary: NEW YORK & WORCESTER, Mass., October 15, 2026--UMass Memorial Health today announced a multi-year initiative with Accenture and Microsoft to modernize its data platform.

headlines.title: Accenture Targets Faster Growth as AI Reinvention Strategy Takes Center Stage
headlines.summary: Accenture (NYSE:ACN) outlined a multiyear growth strategy centered on enterprise AI adoption, large-scale client reinventions, managed services and an expanding network of specialized businesses during its Investor and Analyst Day.

headlines.title: Accenture (ACN) Is Up 10.4% After Dividend Hike And New AI Deals With Dell And Workday
headlines.summary: In early October 2026, Accenture reported fourth-quarter and full-year results showing higher sales and earnings, confirmed guidance for fiscal 2027, increased its quarterly dividend to US$1.71 per share, completed a long-running share repurchase program, and outlined multi-year growth and margin goals at its investor day.

headlines.title: Why Accenture (ACN) Stock Is Trading Up Today
headlines.summary: Shares of global professional services company Accenture (NYSE:ACN) jumped 2.6% in the pre-market session after the company held its first investor day in four years and presented a three-year financial plan calling for mid- to high-single-digit revenue growth in local currency through fiscal year 2029.

headlines.title: Accenture’s Investor Day Answers the AI Question: Why the Street Isn’t Buying It Yet
headlines.summary: Accenture (ACN:NYSE) stock is up about 2% on Wednesday, October 14 (trading near $217), after the consulting giant laid out a three-year financial plan at its investor day. Shares jumped about 4% before the open, then gave back roughly half the gain once trading started.

description: Accenture plc provides strategy and consulting, industry X, song, and technology and operation services in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. It offers systems integration and application management; security; intelligent platform; infrastructure; software engineering; data, AI, cloud; and automation and global delivery services. The company also operates business processes for specific enterprise functions, including finance and accounting, sourcing and procurement, supply chain, marketing and sales, and human resources, as well as industry-specific services, such as platform trust and safety, banking, insurance, network and health services; and designs, manufactures, and assembles automation equipment, robotics, and other commercial hardware products. It serves communications, media, and technology; financial services; banking and capital markets, and insurance; health and public service; consumer goods, retail, travel services; industrial; life science; and chemicals, natural resources, energy, and utilities sectors. Accenture plc has collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to deliver transformative digital services to public sector, defense, and national security organizations. It has a collaboration with OpenAI to help enterprise clients unlock new levels of innovation and growth by bringing agentic AI systems; has a strategic collaboration with Microsoft and Avanade for the development of an agentic factory intelligence system; and INFRONEER Holdings Inc. and SAP Japan Co., Ltd. to develop a new financial data and insights platform. It also has strategic partnership with Netomi, Inc. to help enterprises reinvent customer experience using agentic AI systems. The company has a strategic alliance with ServiceNow for integrated risk management and third-party risk management solutions. Accenture plc was founded in 1951 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
